templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms of the Common Paper Mutual NDA, allowing each party to disclose confidential information to the other while evaluating or pursuing a business relationship.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
templates.description: Cover Page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, capturing the purpose, effective date, MNDA term, term of confidentiality, governing law, jurisdiction and signatures.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering access and use, fees, confidentiality, warranties, liability and termination.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for target uptime, response times and service credits, designed to be used together with the Cloud Service Agreement.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms governing how a provider processes customer personal data as a processor or subprocessor, including security, subprocessors and international transfers.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for engaging a provider to perform professional services and deliverables under one or more Statements of Work (SOWs).

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms setting out a business associate's obligations for using, disclosing and safeguarding protected health information (PHI) under HIPAA.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for giving an early design partner access to a product in development in exchange for feedback.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for licensing software that the customer installs and runs itself, covering the license grant, fees, support, warranties and liability.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for a business partnership in which each party performs agreed obligations, including fees, a mutual trademark license and an escalation procedure.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for a short-term trial or evaluation that lets a prospective customer test a product before committing to a full commercial agreement.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum supplementing a commercial agreement with terms for AI services, covering inputs, outputs, model training and related responsibilities.
